links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid grade level of ChatGPT and CDC vaccination responses versus recommended level
links.effect: Grade levels often exceeded AMA-recommended level of 6; ChatGPT average grade level in English 12.84, Spanish 7.93. CDC outperformed ChatGPT on readability in both languages.
links.quote: However, Flesch-Kincaid grade levels often exceeded the American Medical Association's recommended levels, particularly in English (eg, average grade level in English for ChatGPT=12.84, Spanish=7.93, recommended=6).

links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated patient information relative to plain-language recommendation
links.effect: ChatGPT English responses averaged grade 12.84 and Spanish 7.93 versus recommended 6; CDC responses were more readable than ChatGPT in both languages.
links.quote: CDC responses outperformed ChatGPT in readability across both languages.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT versus CDC answers to vaccination questions in English and Spanish for accuracy, readability, and understandability, without evaluating an organizational deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
